A banquet hall in the heart of Wahga Town

Naveed Marquee is a banquet hall in Wahga Town, Lahore, located near the Ring Road interchange — an easy drive for guests coming from across the city.

It is rated 4.1 out of 5 from 489 reviews, and offers the everyday facilities a wedding or family event needs, including a wheelchair-accessible entrance and both free and paid parking.

  • Banquet hall — weddings & events
  • Wahga Town, Lahore — near Ring Road interchange
  • 4.1 rating — based on 489 reviews

Made for your big days

From the colour of a mehndi to the formality of a walima — a marquee setting that adapts to each function of a Pakistani wedding.

Mehndi

A bright, festive stage setup for the mehndi night — colour, music and family all in one hall.

Barat

A grand hall and stage for the barat — the main wedding day, with room for the whole guest list.

Walima

An elegant dinner setting for the walima reception — round tables, fine seating and a calm, formal mood.

Please note: the photographs on this page are representative images of marquee and banquet events, shown to illustrate the style of celebration — they are not photographs of Naveed Marquee itself. Visit the venue or call to see the actual hall.

Facilities at the venue

The practical details your guests will appreciate on the day.

Wheelchair-Accessible Entrance

Step-free access at the entrance, so every guest can arrive comfortably.

Free Parking

Free parking available for guests arriving by car or bike.

Paid Parking

Additional paid parking options for larger events and busy days.

Restroom

Restroom facilities on site for guests throughout the event.
